status: PRE-SUBMISSION MODEL ESTIMATE — not a validated project forecast

primary_input.data_product: ECMWF ERA5 hourly single levels (10 m and 100 m wind) via the Open-Meteo historical-weather API (models=era5, nearest 0.25 deg cell); lossy redistribution, calibrated against the CDS series over 2014-2024 (Phase 5-PRE), not bit-identical to CDS
primary_input.alpha_note: computed from this series (scripts/03 estimate_shear_alpha) and applied to every hour

comparison_input_not_used_for_results.role: historical baseline (results archive folder baseline_2014_2024_cds) and input QA only

calibration_vs_cds.label: INPUT QA (not a result): primary Open-Meteo ERA5 against the CDS-derived series over the common hours; both are ERA5, distributed and stored differently

direction_100m.note: Open-Meteo direction is in whole degrees

gross_cf.note: same alpha isolates the data difference; own alpha includes the series-specific shear exponent

author_decision: Phase 5-PRE-B: primary period 1994-2024, calibrated Open-Meteo ERA5, same node; neighbouring nodes are sensitivity experiments; GWA scaling is not a correction
